name: thothsyn-extension
description: Thothsyn — 本地优先的超级书签（Chrome / Firefox 版）

scripts.dev:firefox: node scripts/sync-readme.mjs && node scripts/sync-i18n.mjs && wxt -b firefox --mv3
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/sync-readme.mjs && node scripts/sync-i18n.mjs && wxt build -b firefox --mv3
scripts.zip:firefox: node scripts/sync-readme.mjs && node scripts/sync-i18n.mjs && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3
